text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Returning in triumph with so many girls in 
tow— splendidly done, Trainer!
choice_data_list: I wonder if your prayers were answered.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my...! I am overjoyed to have 
fulfilled my duty as the Holy Maiden.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
However, this result is truly thanks to 
your exceptional skill, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"I will pass down today's events as a 
verse in the Saint's epic poem, even in 
the otherworld."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"First... I must make sure to practice 
thoroughly against these little ones♪"
